units.crop_amounts: Decimal strings in whole CROP unless the field ends in _wei.
units.timestamps: UTC ISO-8601 or Unix seconds explicitly named.
units.rounding: Preserve token base units. Source floors rate and accumulator arithmetic; forward projections remain scenario estimates.

plots.trait_effect: Traits inform fixed rarity/art; no independent crop/soil yield multiplier is documented.
plots.rarity_freeze: Published as finalized after reveal; token-to-row mapping must be read after reveal.

verified_reveal_behavior.zero_starting_index: Unrevealed sentinel in this deployment; reveal maps hash modulo 3333 equal to zero onto one.
verified_reveal_behavior.offset_probability: Uniform-3333-offset probabilities are hypothetical. A uniform 256-bit hash model gives offset one the combined residues zero and one; hash uniformity and lack of influence are not established.
verified_reveal_behavior.tier_assignment: Owner sets rarityTier after reveal and may revise it until tiersFinalized. A default zero tier does not prove Common; compare finalized tier, committed manifest and synchronized weight.

planting.ownership_effect: NFT stays in the wallet. Activation is tied to ownership and clears on transfer.
planting.eligibility_note: V3 requires plantingOpen and both live farm links. Sprouts additionally require Genesis. All companion actions are individually reviewed.

seed_bag.eligibility: Owned dormant plot that has never been planted in V2 or V3; planting open, bag open, funded bag available. One per plot lifetime.
seed_bag.execution_policy: Separate payable method; never substitute for a CROP approval/plant without explicit user review.
seed_bag.repricing_enforcement: No bag repricing setter in V3.

sprouts.eligibility: Owned dormant previously planted plot, after Genesis, sprouts open and funded treasury burn.
sprouts.pricing: Fresh sproutPrice getter; owner can reprice above minimum, keeper has configurable band, step and cooldown.
sprouts.payment: Contract accepts at least current price and refunds excess. Companion submits the exact reviewed quote and rechecks it before submission.

levels.upgrade_steps: Advance one level at a time; costToReach(next_level) is the incremental payment, not a cumulative total.
levels.approval_spender: FarmLevels deployment; each upgrade burns the exact incremental next-level amount.
levels.eligibility_note: Source checks ownership, levels pause and level cap, but does not require planting or Genesis. Dormant upgrades earn nothing until activated; companion policy waits for Genesis.

yield.ordinary_yield_per_second: Nominal: 2000 CROP / 604800 * plot_weight_units * FirstSoil * weather; dormant plots earn zero. Annual base ceiling and finite Granary can reduce payout.
yield.portfolio_yield_per_second: Nominal: 2000 CROP / 604800 * own active weight * First Soil * weather. Schedule/carry and finite Granary may limit payout; total valley weight affects those limits, not the uncapped rate.
yield.portfolio_marginal_yield_per_second: Recompute the whole portfolio with and without the extra weight, with identical initial carry, Granary, weather and horizon; compare earned CROP.

variables.P: Tracked currently planted weight across every included wallet.
variables.B: Base before multipliers, limited by schedule plus carry.
variables.m: First Soil times capped weather; surplus limited by Granary.

yield.zero_weight_policy: Portfolio rate is zero; elapsed schedule enters carry. After activation, the nominal rate remains bounded and prior unused schedule can support its future base; no immediate lump-sum backlog claim.
yield.accrual: Published as continuous. Claiming realizes pending tokens; it does not itself increase weight.
yield.compounding: Only spending earned tokens on a yield-changing action compounds; pending rewards are not spendable balances.
limitations: Future weight, weather, prices, fees, reserves and deposits are assumptions; label them.
Segment-rate and accumulator rounding can differ from actual transaction history.
No unverified future tarp, fertilizer or lottery profit is included.
Live rarity requires finalized tiers, manifest agreement and synchronized weight.

emissions.after_year_4: Rate stops after four 365-day years; unused carry and Granary become sweepable subject to reward liabilities.

verified_accounting.annual_rate_rounding: floor(year_budget_wei / YEAR), then multiplied by segment seconds.
verified_accounting.settlement: Split at year, weather/event, Founding Week and First Soil boundaries. Base=min(nominal rate for totalWeight over segment, carry + elapsed schedule budget). Carry=available-base. Apply combined soil/weather multiplier after the ceiling.
verified_accounting.granary: Combined multiplier above one draws up to available Granary; below one replenishes it. Idle schedule enters carry, not Granary.
verified_accounting.rate_getter: farmRatePerSec is next-24-hour accrual at current weight and stored scheduled weather divided by 86400, not an instantaneous rate.
verified_accounting.projection_limit: Carry and Granary are finite stocks consumed once per segment; forecasts depend on starting balances, future total weight and weather. Exact accumulator floors and future transaction timing remain approximations.

emissions.ceiling_scope: Base before First Soil and weather. Unspent schedule budget enters carry, distinct from Granary.

weather.granary_behavior: First Soil times weather above one draws the available buffer; below one replenishes it. Idle schedule enters carry. The weather/event cap of 2x applies before First Soil.

events.name: Harvest Moon
events.notice: Town Hall currently advertises at least 30 days ahead; not a guaranteed immutable schedule.

weather.forecast_policy: Use verified explicit schedules only for announced future weeks; a getter may inherit prior weather. On log-history failure, read reviewed slot-2 schedule entries at the same block.
weather.event_planning_model: Double weekly BPS once for a covering Flood and once for a covering Moon, then cap at 20000. Source confirms simultaneous Flood and Moon stacking. Same-kind overlapping input windows are rejected as ambiguous duplicates.
weather.verified_event_behavior: multiplierAt applies each covering event independently before the total 2x cap; nominal multiplier remains subject to emissions Granary availability.
weather.verified_schedule_conflict: Historical direct-owner replacement finding is not current ownership evidence. Oracle runtime is unchanged, but owner is now the published Weather Seal. Seal source and keeper permissions need a separate verification before claiming immutable outcomes.
weather.first_soil_cap_note: Founding Week and a 2x capped weather/event multiplier combine to 4x while Granary can pay.

harvest.batch_scope: Caller-owned plots; combine within each wallet, not across ownership boundaries.
harvest.unclaimed_rewards: Travel with the NFT on transfer under the published rule.
harvest.pause: Owner can pause claims; published policy says pending rewards keep accruing.
harvest.verified_claim_behavior: Claims settle historical rewards and synchronize weights. One invalid owner in claimMany reverts the whole batch; claims pause independently of the levels pause. No token allowance is required.

transfers.preplant_note: Moving a never-planted plot incurs no lost prior activation, but still has transfer costs and subsequent initial planting.
transfers.verified_sync_behavior: NFT calls its NativeActivation transfer hook, which clears activation and attempts emissions synchronization. Caught hook failures can leave stale recorded weight until sync or claim.

fees.swap_fee_recipient: Liquidity providers of the CROP Uniswap pool; no site fee according to current Almanac.

supplies.name: Fertilizer
supplies.planned_effect: 25% additional plot weight for one week

supplies.name: Greenhouse Tarp
supplies.planned_effect: Floor the plot's weather multiplier at 1x for the coming week

store.optimization_policy: Exclude cosmetics as yield investments. Supply pricing, activation, stacking and settlement require confirmation before recommendations.
store.expected_opening: Later in 2026; final opening not specified

drawings.prize: Market-bought plot; Town Hall also mentions cosmetics.
drawings.budget_policy: Budget capped by that week's tickets burned; thin weeks may roll forward.
drawings.draw_policy: Seed committed before entry window, revealed at drawing.
drawings.optimization_policy: Do not recommend purchased tickets without complete odds, ticket cost, prize valuation, and confirmed final rules.

token_allocations.airdrop: Published as unclaimable; entire pool designated for Granary after its deadline.
token_allocations.team_vesting: Published as six-month cliff then two years linear; exact release curve is not independently verified.
token_allocations.treasury_no_market_sales_year_one: Published policy with an explicit exception: pool ceiling ranges convert treasury CROP into ETH retained in the pool as price rises. Not a contract-enforced blanket prohibition.
token_allocations.airdrop_sweep_condition: Permissionless sweep requires block.timestamp strictly after 2027-03-01T00:00:00Z. A transaction must actually transfer the remaining balance; do not pre-credit forecasts.
token_allocations.airdrop_claim_evidence: Almanac says no allocation to claimants. Current source supports valid Merkle claims against an immutable nonzero root; lack of eligible leaves/proofs was not independently proven. No visitor allocation or free CROP is assumed.

schedule.reveal: At sellout, or by September 18 18:00 UTC; current Almanac has an explicit deadline.
schedule.reveal_note: Permissionless reveal after the relevant sellout block or immutable deadline still requires a transaction. Date alone is not proof of reveal.

published_immutable_claims: No reseeding of already committed weather weeks
published_owner_powers: Replace activation source behind stated resync guards
Set store listings/prices/supplies and later lock them
Set royalty up to its cap
administration.owner_control: Refresh owner/keeper wiring. Weather owner is the published seal at the September 26 review; historical shared owner wording is obsolete.
administration.audit_claims: Historical site audit claims retained in history/2026-09-07; not independently reproduced. Current security URL is a moved-page pointing to Provenance.
administration.source_verification: Six current core Sourcify exact-match source records independently matched pinned runtime bytecode at block 60592342. Targeted review, not compiler reproduction or a full audit.
verified_conflicts: Historical direct-owner replacement finding is not current ownership evidence. Oracle runtime is unchanged, but owner is now the published Weather Seal. Seal source and keeper permissions need a separate verification before claiming immutable outcomes.
Reveal still remaps residue zero to one. Tiers are now finalized at the reviewed block.
Sprouts price is mutable; seed-bag price is fixed and eligibility is lifetime first planting only.

onboarding.wallets: EVM wallets including MetaMask and Rabby
onboarding.initial_crop: Swap for CROP when available, or published ETH seed bag can plant without acquiring initial CROP. No claimable airdrop is assumed.
onboarding.bridge_quote_policy: Routing availability, fees and waits are time-sensitive; obtain fresh quotes instead of treating promotional estimates as constants.

derived.historical_personal_count_examples: Fields mentioning 11/22 are arithmetic examples only, not public defaults or ownership.

orchard.formula: Funded weekly basket × wallet actual weekly CROP production / valley actual weekly CROP production.
orchard.accounting: Production belongs to the earning wallet even after a plot sale. Buying CROP or claiming old harvest does not count.
orchard.claims: Only after week close and verified allocations; no CROP cost or approval, ETH gas required. Verified unclaimed rewards do not expire.
orchard.funding: Future pots are discretionary; an unfunded week pays zero.
orchard.implementation: Official Orchard link; do not estimate AAPL from current balances, pending CROP or instantaneous weight. No companion Orchard claim executor.
